verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs say its APIs expose account, payment, card and transaction data, with real-time balances, so an agent can read the core banking picture programmatically rather than scraping the dashboard. Pending activity and documents/statements are not evidenced, there is no MCP surface, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec or markdown docs. Missing for 10: documented pending/authorization activity access, documents/statements API, an MCP server, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read the full banking picture — accounts, transactions, pending activity, documents — through a clean API or MCP surface without screen-scraping a dashboard

citations.quote: The Unit Dashboard and APIs provide teams with access to customer, account, payment, card, transaction, compliance, and operational data.
with real-time balances and transaction data
Companies can build directly on the Unit Platform using APIs and components
